patternCandidates.name: Programme home with sticky share footer
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain lands on a programme (referral) hub: show what they've earned, the offers available and one primary action
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader(back,title,Help pill) > hero campaign banner > summary card(label, ₹ amount, chevron, optional avatar-stack nudge) > section title > list of offer rows(illustration tile, value headline, segment caption, chevron) > sticky footer(code chip + Copy tertiary, full-width primary)
patternCandidates.variations: zero earnings (1144:67947) drops avatar nudge and Copy; no-campaign empty state (1442:8189); customer-referral section added (1693:4081)
patternCandidates.conflicts: Footer: code chip+Copy (987:6275) vs plain text no Copy (1144:67947); code-at-top layout in 1000:7232/4150:22983 and Kitchen

patternCandidates.name: Milestone stepper / progress timeline
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Reward unlocks over sequential milestones (activation, N rides) and captain must see done/locked steps and value of each
patternCandidates.structure: Status header(title + status Tag + 'x/3 completed') > vertical timeline: done step = green numbered badge, title, timestamp, '+₹X' green; locked step = grey lock badge, grey title/amount, deadline/'--'; dashed connector
patternCandidates.variations: campaign 'how it works' variant with right-side green 'You Earn ₹X' blocks (1000:7137); referee view with 'N days left' (2684:40683)
patternCandidates.conflicts: Two visual styles for the same milestone concept (how-it-works cards with green reward pills vs detail timeline)

patternCandidates.name: Person detail with nudge panel
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain views one referred person and should nudge them to the next step
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader > profile row(avatar, name/role, right-aligned earnings value + caption) > progress block > bottom tinted panel(title 'Tell X to…', subtitle, read-only message preview) > full-width primary 'Send Reminder' with channel icon (WhatsApp/SMS)
patternCandidates.variations: SMS vs WhatsApp icon; extra 'Call' secondary (4338:11584); terminal states drop panel (1028:8921, 1020:8780 with info banner)
patternCandidates.conflicts: Kitchen 'Get Raj to Activate' alternative wording

patternCandidates.name: Tabbed tracker list with row action
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain tracks many people/items split by status and acts per row
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader > summary card w/ illustration > PrimaryTabs(2) > search field > rows(avatar, small progress label, name, coloured status text, trailing outlined small button or +₹ amount)
patternCandidates.conflicts: status colours ad hoc (green/amber/red text) instead of Tag

patternCandidates.name: Contact picker with per-row channel invite
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain invites people from phone contacts
patternCandidates.structure: InternalPageHeader > search field > section title > rows(initials avatar, name, number, trailing pill 'Invite' with WhatsApp (green) or SMS (black) icon)
patternCandidates.conflicts: Invite pill not a Runway Button variant

patternCandidates.name: Celebration card over dimmed home
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain just earned a reward and should be pushed to the next milestone
patternCandidates.structure: Dimmed home > floating rounded card w/ gradient(3D illustration, small caption, big ₹ amount, sentence with bolded numbers) > in-card full-width primary
patternCandidates.variations: 'You are activated Rohit!' card in Kitchen; Runway Modal/Toast placed alongside for comparison (2509:37682/37683)

patternCandidates.name: Image interstitial / video overlay
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Promote a campaign or explain via video on entering the programme
patternCandidates.structure: Dimmed page > close X top-right > tall rounded media card (image or video) > optional primary below card
patternCandidates.variations: video (Hindi) vs static image with CTA

patternCandidates.name: Inline programme entry points
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Make a programme discoverable from existing surfaces
patternCandidates.structure: Side-menu row (icon, title, 'Earn upto ₹X' subtitle) / promo strip on wallet / quick-action tile on home / progress strip at top of Incentives
